title: Low Hemoglobin and Ferritin with Iron Supplement Prescription
description: Report with low hemoglobin and ferritin below printed ranges, plus an accompanying prescription.
raw_text:
COMMUNITY HEALTH CLINIC
Patient ID: PT-003
Date: 2026-11-10
--------------------------------------------------
Hemoglobin: 9.8 g/dL (Ref Range: 12.0 - 15.5)
Serum Ferritin: 11.5 ng/mL (Ref Range: 20.0 - 200.0)
Total Iron Binding Capacity (TIBC): 420 ug/dL (Ref Range: 250 - 400)
--------------------------------------------------
PRESCRIPTION:
1. Tab. Ferrous Sulphate 200 mg | 1-0-0 after breakfast | 30 days
2. Tab. Vitamin C 500 mg | 1-0-0 with iron tablet | 30 days
--------------------------------------------------
Note: Follow up in 4 weeks.

values.explanation: Lower than the range printed on your report. Low hemoglobin can cause fatigue or weakness.
Below the printed range. Ferritin indicates your body's stored iron levels.
Higher than the printed range. TIBC measures the blood's capacity to bind iron.

medicines.name: Ferrous Sulphate 200 mg
medicines.purpose: Iron supplement commonly prescribed when hemoglobin or ferritin is low.
watch_for: Dark stools are common and harmless
Inform doctor if severe stomach pain occurs

medicines.name: Vitamin C 500 mg
medicines.purpose: Ascorbic acid tablet, often taken alongside iron to enhance iron absorption.
watch_for: Consult doctor if acid reflux occurs

doctor_questions: What could be causing my low hemoglobin level?
For how many weeks should I take the iron supplement before repeating the test?
Are there specific dietary changes that can support my iron levels?
extracted_data.disclaimer: This explains your report. It does not replace your doctor.
